entity.summary: Non-custodial Bitcoin wallet lineage launched in 2018 and later expanded with Lightning Network support across Android and iOS.
entity.notes: Muun's first-party launch post announces the non-custodial wallet on 2018-10-10.

products.summary: Muun mobile wallet for self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning use across Android and iOS.
products.notes: First-party launch material establishes the Android product lineage on 2018-10-10; first-party iOS release material establishes iOS addition on 2019-10-21.

events.title: Muun 2.0 launched
events.description: Muun announced the launch of Muun 2.0 on 2021-01-11, describing it as a major iteration of the mobile Bitcoin and Lightning wallet following the earlier Muun 1.0 release.

evidence.title: Introducing Muun: A Secure Checking Account for Bitcoin
evidence.notes: First-party launch post announces Muun on 2018-10-10 and explicitly describes it as non-custodial.

evidence.title: Muun releases non-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning wallet for iOS
evidence.notes: First-party iOS release establishes the iOS product surface and states that the Android version already existed.

evidence.title: Muun Terms of use
evidence.notes: Muun's first-party terms state that the only official Muun wallet is the version distributed by Muun through official app stores. This supports continued official product distribution without inferring launch timing.

evidence.title: Announcing Muun 2.0
evidence.notes: First-party Muun announcement explicitly describes the Muun 2.0 launch.
